about: One-time change applied to data/ats_map.json the first time the rebuilt weekly search runs. Built In is no longer a source: each company below is pointed at its own job board, and acquired companies at their parent. 'remove' drops an entry (only if it still names Built In or names nothing) so the company is read from its own careers page instead.

Alarm.com.evidence: job-board feed read live on 2026-10-09: 85 jobs; replaces Built In

Auction.com.evidence: jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/auction/CANDIDATEPORTAL found 2026-10-09; feed not read from here. If it is wrong the careers page is used instead; replaces Built In

Avail (Realtor.com).evidence: part of Realtor.com; hires through Realtor.com

Bilt Rewards.evidence: jobs.gem.com/bilt opened in a browser 2026-10-09: about 20 postings. Read by opening the board in the headless browser

Buildium (RealPage).evidence: Buildium hires through RealPage's shared job board

CertifID.evidence: certifid.com/company/careers loads api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/certifid (seen in a browser 2026-10-09; feed read live, 1 job). The Lever board on file returned nothing: jobs.lever.co/certifid is a 404

Compass.evidence: job-board feed read live on 2026-10-09: postings link to compass.com/careers; replaces Built In

The earlier board name 'onefootprint' no longer exists (404 since 2026-09-30); an earlier note called 'footprint' a different board, which was true then and isn't now
